Install the APK over the existing LBS app to keep projects stored on your device.

Browse 24 configurable furniture designs and 352 Meraki finishes. Choose a product or a saved project, then tap **View in room**. On devices with supported room tracking, slowly scan a clear floor area large enough for the design. The app places the model at its configured dimensions when it detects a suitable upward-facing plane.

For a photo-based preview, tap **Use camera & photo placement**, then **Freeze & auto-place**, or choose a room photo. The app suggests a visually clear area. Position and scale can be adjusted manually.
